sources.title: Qualcomm NPU (QNN, HTP) — sherpa 1.3 documentation
sources.snippet: Qualcomm NPU (QNN, HTP) This section explains how to run sherpa-onnx on a Qualcomm NPU using QNN with the HTP backend. You’ll need a device equipped with a Qualcomm SM8350 processor or a newer, more powerful one, such as the SM8450, SM8475, SM8550, SM8650, SM8750, SM8850, and so on.
